summary: refactor(settings): move browser Sentry callers to @fxa/shared/sentry-browser
description:
Because:

- The browser Sentry code lives in @fxa/shared/sentry-browser, and
  fxa-shared/sentry/browser is a shim.

This commit:

- Imports @fxa/shared/sentry-browser in fxa-settings and fxa-admin-panel.
- Points the jest mocks and requires in the settings tests at the lib.
- Maps @fxa/shared/sentry-browser and sentry-utils in the settings jest config.

Closes FXA-14701
